Marketing Manager, Lifecycle
Bracken & Pine Outfitters, Inc. - Portland, OR (Hybrid)

About Bracken & Pine
Bracken & Pine Outfitters is a growing outdoor apparel company with 40 stores across the Pacific Northwest and an online store that ships nationwide.

What you'll do
- Own the email and SMS lifecycle program: welcome, browse abandonment, post-purchase and win-back journeys
- Build and test campaigns in Klaviyo; report weekly on revenue per recipient and unsubscribe rate
- Partner with the e-commerce, creative and customer service teams on seasonal launches
- Manage a $250K annual budget and one marketing coordinator
- Other duties as assigned

What you'll bring
- 5+ years in lifecycle or CRM marketing, ideally in retail or consumer goods
- Hands-on experience with Klaviyo, Braze or Iterable
- Comfort with A/B testing and basic SQL

Pay and benefits
The salary range for this role is $105,000 to $125,000 per year. We cover 100% of employee health premiums, offer a 401(k) match, and reimburse certification fees for approved courses. We provide your laptop and all equipment.

How to apply
Apply through our careers page at brackenandpine.com/careers. We will never ask you to pay for anything or to share your bank details during the hiring process. Direct deposit details and I-9 documents (such as a passport or driver's license) are collected through our HR system after an offer is accepted.
